reviews.text: Dr Sameera mam is an outstanding eye specialist. Doctor explained my eye condition very clearly and provided the best treatment with great patience and attention. reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience with Dr Sameera. She was extremely professional, patient, and took the time to explain everything clearly. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for excellent eye care.
